model_annotation: This graphic presents three donut charts comparing enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021. Each chart is divided into four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services. In the chart showing the number of enterprises, the sectors are labeled as follows: industry (yellow, 8%, 2.4 million), construction (blue, 12%, 3.7 million), trade (red, 19%, 5.9 million), and other services (purple, 61%, 19.0 million). A legend is provided below the charts, and no percentages are written inside the sections. The second chart, representing the number of persons employed, has the following labels: industry (yellow, 21%, 33.0 million), construction (blue, 9%, 13.4 million), trade (red, 19%, 29.5 million), and other services (purple, 51%, 80.2 million). The third chart, indicating turnover, displays: industry (yellow, 33%, 10.6 trillion), construction (blue, 6%, 1.9 trillion), trade (red, 31%, 9.9 trillion), and other services (purple, 31%, 9.8 trillion). The sectors in each chart appear to be arranged in descending order by value.
